execution_spec_audit.provenance_caveat: Matching instrument specifications and server labels do not independently authenticate that the OHLC history came from the named broker/feed.

source_provenance_caveat: MT5 API is declared in the bundled sidecars; this script does not independently authenticate the broker or certify future executable fills.

execution_assumptions.ohlc_quote_convention: Input OHLC treated as bid-side prices
execution_assumptions.entry: next bar open; long fills at ask (bid open + bar spread) and short fills at bid; adverse slippage applied
execution_assumptions.spread: MT5 bar spread points multiplied by configurable point_size when positive; otherwise fixed fallback USD spread
execution_assumptions.slippage: Adverse price slippage per side; stops and end-of-data exits slippage-adjusted; take-profit limit fill assumes no exit slippage after touch
execution_assumptions.intrabar_collision: If a candle touches both stop and target, stop is filled first
execution_assumptions.gap_handling: A gap through stop fills at the worse opening executable quote plus slippage
execution_assumptions.sizing: Fixed fractional equity risk with executable stop distance including stop slippage and round-trip commission estimate; lot sizes rounded down to lot_step
execution_assumptions.concurrency: Concurrent positions are capped independently within each timeframe run; a slot is not reused based on unknown intrabar exit order
execution_assumptions.end_of_data: Remaining positions are closed at the last close with spread/slippage assumptions and marked END_OF_DATA
execution_assumptions.time_stop: Optional maximum holding cap of None bars; entry bar counts as bar 1. Stop/target logic has priority, otherwise exits occur at the completed bar close with adverse slippage and quote-side spread treatment.
execution_assumptions.common_window_method: In common-window mode, earlier history is retained as warm-up/context; only signal bars at or after common_start are eligible, and execution stops at common_end. This can differ from Phase 3C counts produced by re-running detection on a window-only slice.

H4.drawdown_basis: Close-to-close mark-to-market equity; open positions are hypothetically liquidated at the executable close quote with modeled slippage and round-turn commission. OHLC cannot reveal intrabar equity minima.
H4.note: Net profit and final equity include end-of-data liquidation P&L. Win rate, profit factor, expectancy, and average R exclude END_OF_DATA exits; TIME_STOP exits are rule exits. Max drawdown is close-to-close mark-to-market; realized-only drawdown is separately reported.
